author: From Staff Reports
title: Everett's Music Barn to host fall fundraiser this weekend - NewsBreak
text:
By From Staff Reports ,
14 hours ago Everett’s Music Barn in Suwanee will host its annual fall fundraiser on Saturday from noon to 10 p.m. If you enjoy bluegrass music, Suwanee is the place to be this weekend.
Everett’s Music Barn is hosting its annual fall fundraiser, which features 10 hours of bluegrass music starting at noon. Different bands will take the stage each hour.
The venue, located at 4055 Stonecypher Road, is alcohol free. Admission to Saturday’s festival is free but there is a donation bucket at the entrance to the barn (cash and checks only). And organizers said there will be raffle drawings between each show.
There will be hotdogs, barbecue sandwiches, soft drinks and delicious desserts available.
The musical lineup includes:
♦ Noon: The Great Divide, two sets
♦ 2 p.m.: Hayden Reidling & friends
♦ 3 p.m.: The Grasscutters, two sets
♦ 5 p.m.: Darryl Wilson
♦ 6 p.m.: THE Oak Grove Band
♦ 7 p.m.: Jeff Patridge & friends
♦ 8 p.m.: 501 Central
♦ 9 p.m. Hayden Reidling & more friends
For more info, go to: everettsmusicbarn.net
